evidence.observation: Stable ~3.15 Torr throughout ramp at Ar 100 sccm
Rose steadily from 3.19 to 3.53 Torr during growth, with no setpoint change
MFC reading steady at ~100 sccm, matching setpoint, so the rise is not caused by extra flow
Temperature steady at 750 °C after a brief overshoot; heater power normal
Exhaust O2 sensor not installed, so the atmosphere cannot be verified, which the growth stage requires

args.missing_evidence: Exhaust O2 reading or a leak-up/rate-of-rise test (isolate pump, watch pressure). Air ingress (seal leak) and exhaust blockage both raise pressure; these tests would tell them apart. Also need the normal-run pressure ref during growth.
